name: RepoPact Core
summary: Repository-native governance CLI and canonical semantic engine for durable work between people and coding agents.
maturity: The CLI is released; development continues. The published package and the evolving source tree have separate release boundaries.

name: RepoPact Workbench
summary: A native interface for exploring RepoPact records and reviewing supported changes.
maturity: Preview software built from source. Its build, packaging, and platform acceptance are separate from the released Core CLI.

name: Anvil
summary: A local-first planning ledger for projects, issues, boards, workflows, and typed relations to external work records.
maturity: The current preview uses a single-writer store; its API and schema may change.

name: SkillForge Academy
summary: An offline-first learning application for structured courses, guided instruction, practical work, and certification preparation.
maturity: A Windows application is published. The newer course-platform work is in beta development and has a separate maturity boundary.

name: ForgeWire
summary: A private application exploring coordinated models, agents, tools, memory, compute, and distributed execution.
maturity: No public build, supported install path, stable API, or announced release date.

name: Fabric
summary: A private project in development within the ForgeWire Labs ecosystem.
maturity: The implementation is private. No public download or release date has been announced.

name: ForgeLink
summary: Locally owned communication and coordination for people, agents, and applications.
maturity: A packaged release is available. The latest repository code can be ahead of the packaged installer; check its release notes for the exact released feature set.
